title: Numerical experiments for Graph-Induced Tensor Liftings for Networked SEIR Models
description: Versioned Python code, synthetic numerical outputs, LaTeX tables, and PDF figures supporting the numerical illustrations in Section 5 of the article Graph-Induced Tensor Liftings for Networked SEIR Models: Dimensional Reduction and Residual Analysis.
notes: Release v1.0.2 aligns notation, terminology, documentation, tests, and metadata with the final manuscript. Numerical results are unchanged from v1.0.1. Zenodo will assign the version-specific DOI when this new version is published.
